name: Inventive
description:
Contributing to the defenses of the Kepland has taught you how to make complex things out of mundane materials.

Once per Intermezzo, you may spend at least 1 day inventing a helpful contraption. When you finish the contraption, roll Craft with +1d for each day spent working on it beyond the first, then divide the result by 5. The contraption gains a number of charges equal to the divided result. Choose a skill for the contraption.

A creature wearing or wielding the contraption may spend a half action to activate it before making a check with the chosen skill. When activated, the creature may expend any number of the contraption's remaining charges, gaining +1d on the check for each charge spent.

When the contraption has no charges remaining, it breaks.

Describe your contraption.
